claims.claim: A baler machine is a useful piece of recycling equipment.
claims.evidence: The structure and hydraulic components in photos 0, 1, and 2 are consistent with a vertical baler.

claims.claim: The press installed within the baler...

risks.risk: The hydraulic pump and motor may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the machine running and the press plate moving through a full cycle.
risks.if_unproven: as a non-functional frame and cylinder

risks.risk: The hydraulic seals may leak under actual compression load.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine compressing material (like cardboard or plastic) without fluid leaks.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a hydraulic system overhaul

risks.risk: The structural welds may be poor quality, leading to frame failure under pressure.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the main structural welds and the internal chamber.

proof_requests: Video of the machine in operation showing the press plate moving up and down.
Photo of the electric motor and the hydraulic pump assembly.
Photo of the interior of the baling chamber.
Confirmation of the compression force (tonnage) and motor horsepower.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a locally fabricated vertical baler. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit until the motor and hydraulic operation are proven.
